#### *Answered as* ‘Outline the pharmacology of Metoprolol’

Metoprolol is a selective B1 receptor antagonist Used to treat hypertension, heart failure, Rate control in AF/Atrial Flutter. 

Physiochemical 

Presentation: Clear colourless solution 5mg/5ml, or as tablet 

Dose: IV 1-2mg 2min titrated to effect max 10mg

Pharmacokinetics

Absorption: Oral Bioavailability 50% single dose 70% if repeated     

Distribution: Plasma Protein Binding 10%, moderate lipid solubility, crosses BBB, Vd \~4L/kg 

Metabolism: Hepatic metabolism Primarily by CYP2D6, subject to genetic polymorphism  

Elimination: Renally excreted \<10% unchanged T1/2 3-4 hours 

Pharmacodynamics

CVS: ↓Chronotropy ↓inotropy ↓dromotropy →↓CO/MAP and ↓CMRO2

Minimal effect on normal / resting heart where PSNS effect dominates

Resp: Bronchoconstriction at higher doses 

CNS: Fatigue, sleep disturbance
